headline: ICTSI selloff drags PSEi to 6-year low
summary: The PSEi fell 3.12% to close at 5,306.98, its lowest level since April 2020. Investors sold index heavyweights led by port operator ICTSI.
why: The PSEi is the benchmark index of the Philippine Stock Exchange, and its heavyweight constituents drive much of its performance.
why_moved: Investors sold index heavyweights, led by ICTSI, pushing the benchmark to its weakest close in over six years.
